+        "pts": [(532, 651), (545, 670), (559, 691), (576, 713), (586, 722)],
+        "press": [(0.00, 4.8), (0.45, 6.0), (0.80, 6.4), (1.00, 5.8)],
+    },
+    {
+        "name": "lower right dot",
+        "pts": [(663, 653), (684, 676), (708, 704), (734, 734), (752, 758)],
+        "press": [(0.00, 5.0), (0.35, 6.1), (0.72, 7.0), (1.00, 6.5)],
+    },
+]
+
+
+def catmull_rom(points: list[tuple[float, float]], step_px: float = SAMPLE_PX) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Smoothly interpolate a short, hand-traced stroke and sample by distance."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
+    samples: list[np.ndarray] = []
+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
+        p0 = p[i - 1] if i > 0 else p[i]
+        p1, p2 = p[i], p[i + 1]
+        p3 = p[i + 2] if i + 2 < len(p) else p[i + 1]
+        n = max(2, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1) / step_px)))
+        t = np.arange(n, dtype=np.float64) / n
+        t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
+        seg = 0.5 * (
+            (2 * p1)[None, :]
+            + (-p0 + p2)[None, :] * t[:, None]
+            + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3)[None, :] * t2[:, None]
+            + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3)[None, :] * t3[:, None]
+        )
+        samples.extend(seg)
+    samples.append(p[-1])
+    raw = np.asarray(samples, dtype=np.float64)
+    # Re-sample the spline at a uniform arc distance so target speeds stay smooth.
+    ds = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(raw, axis=0), axis=1)
+    s = np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(ds)))
+    if s[-1] < 1e-6:
+        return raw[:1]
+    n_out = max(2, int(math.ceil(s[-1] / step_px)))
+    so = np.linspace(0.0, s[-1], n_out + 1)
+    return np.column_stack([np.interp(so, s, raw[:, k]) for k in range(2)])
+
+
+def target_pixel_to_world(u: float, v: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    # Pixel centers are (u+0.5,v+0.5); paper Y points from the far edge toward robot.
+    x = -0.100 + SHEET_HALF_M - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_TARGET_PX / 1000.0
+    y = SHEET_HALF_M - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_TARGET_PX / 1000.0
+    return x, y
+
+
+def stroke_targets(stroke: dict) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    uv = catmull_rom(stroke["pts"])
+    arc = np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(uv, axis=0), axis=1))))
+    t = arc / max(arc[-1], 1e-9)
+    knots = np.asarray(stroke["press"], dtype=np.float64)
+    press = np.interp(t, knots[:, 0], knots[:, 1])
+    xy = np.asarray([target_pixel_to_world(u, v) for u, v in uv], dtype=np.float64)
+    z = PAPER_Z_M - press / 1000.0
+    P = np.column_stack((xy, z, np.repeat(Q_DOWN[None, :], len(xy), axis=0)))
+    return P.astype(np.float32), uv
+
+
+def preview() -> None:
+    im = Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
+    for i, st in enumerate(STROKES):
+        _, uv = stroke_targets(st)
+        col = ((31 * i + 220) % 255, (83 * i + 65) % 255, (137 * i + 35) % 255)
+        xy = [tuple(map(float, pt)) for pt in uv]
+        draw.line(xy, fill=col, width=3)
+        draw.text(xy[0], str(i + 1), fill="white", stroke_width=1, stroke_fill="black")
+    out = OUT / "planned_strokes.png"
+    im.save(out)
+    print(out)
+
+
+def submit_hold(robot: Robot, pose: np.ndarray, rows: int, note: str) -> dict:
+    A = np.repeat(np.asarray(pose, dtype=np.float32)[None, :], rows, axis=0)
+    r = robot.submit("ee_pose", A, dt=CONTROL_DT, video="none", cameras=["canvas_cam"], note=note)
+    now = np.asarray(r.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=np.float64)
+    print(f"{note}: tip={now[:3].round(4).tolist()} controls={r.meta.get('control_steps_chunk')}")
+    return r.meta
+
+
+def run() -> None:
+    robot = Robot()
+    status = robot.status()
+    if status.get("done"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"episode already ended: {status}")
+    print("episode", json.dumps(status, sort_keys=True))
+
+    # The brush is dipped in the stone, then moved above the main sheet.
+    ink_above = np.asarray([INK_XY[0], INK_XY[1], HOVER_Z_M, *Q_DOWN], dtype=np.float32)
+    submit_hold(robot, ink_above, 42, "move above ink stone")
+    ink_contact = ink_above.copy()
+    ink_contact[2] = 0.018
+    submit_hold(robot, ink_contact, 22, "dip and load brush")
+    submit_hold(robot, ink_above, 20, "lift loaded brush")
+
+    results: list[dict] = []
+    total_path_mm = 0.0
+    for i, st in enumerate(STROKES, start=1):
+        P, uv = stroke_targets(st)
+        xy0 = P[0, :2]
+        start_hover = np.asarray([xy0[0], xy0[1], HOVER_Z_M, *Q_DOWN], dtype=np.float32)
+        submit_hold(robot, start_hover, 34, f"stroke {i:02d}: hover at {st['name']}")
+        start_contact = P[0].copy()
+        submit_hold(robot, start_contact, 14, f"stroke {i:02d}: establish brush pressure")
+
+        # A few end samples let the tip catch up at the endpoint without extending
+        # the path enough to alter its calligraphic direction.
+        P = np.vstack((P, np.repeat(P[-1][None, :], 4, axis=0)))
+        r = robot.submit(
+            "ee_pose", P, dt=CONTROL_DT, video="none", cameras=["canvas_cam"],
+            note=f"main stroke {i:02d}/12: {st['name']}",
+        )
+        fail_count = sum(int(p.get("ik_failures", 0)) for p in r.meta.get("plan", []))
+        now = np.asarray(r.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], dtype=np.float64)
+        if r.meta.get("stopped") or fail_count:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"stroke {i} interrupted: stopped={r.meta.get('stopped')} IK failures={fail_count}")
+        path_mm = float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(P[:, :2], axis=0), axis=1).sum() * 1000.0)
+        total_path_mm += path_mm
+        print(f"stroke {i:02d}/12 {st['name']}: {len(P)} targets, path={path_mm:.1f} mm, tip={now.round(4).tolist()}")
+        results.append({"stroke": i, "name": st["name"], "targets": len(P), "path_mm": path_mm,
+                        "tip_after": now.tolist(), "ik_failures": fail_count})
+
+        end_hover = np.asarray([P[-1, 0], P[-1, 1], HOVER_Z_M, *Q_DOWN], dtype=np.float32)
+        submit_hold(robot, end_hover, 20, f"stroke {i:02d}: lift clear")
+
+    # Leave the sheet unobstructed for its recorded final camera image.
+    clear = np.asarray([-0.100, 0.000, 0.400, *Q_DOWN], dtype=np.float32)
+    submit_hold(robot, clear, 40, "move clear of main sheet")
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam", "scene_cam"], video="none")
+    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"final_{camera}.png")
+    final = {
+        "protocol": robot.spec().get("protocol"),
+        "status": robot.status(),
+        "brush_calibration": {"press_mm": [2.2, 5.7, 8.2], "observed_width_mm": [2, 6, 9]},
+        "main_strokes": results,
+        "planned_path_mm": total_path_mm,
+    }
+    (OUT / "run_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(final, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(final, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if "--preview" in sys.argv:
+        preview()
+    else:
+        run()
*** End Patch";
